text:
morgan: FYI ACME hit p95 spikes on /v1/generate starting 2026-03-16 09:00 UTC. Customer attached 4 request IDs from the window: req_8a3f, req_8a41, req_8a9c, req_8b00. Need a minimal latency-sample bundle (curl snippets + promptset + concurrency plan) we can run in staging to reproduce.

kiara: Thanks — SLA is 99.9% for this customer, will loop them in. Any immediate mitigations?

morgan: Throttled a few large-batch requests, switched them to lower throughput queue; issue still appears. No auth or billing errors. From logs p50 fine, p95 jumps when token counts > 2k.

devon: Can you paste a representative payload and the exact request IDs? Also, what's the avg tokens per request? We need token histogram + whether KV cache hit rate was low.

morgan: tokens: ~400-2300 across the ids above. Attaching short promptset below. Also added a quick curl we used to repro locally.

morgan: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \
  -H 'X-Request-ID: req_8a3f' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"gptx-3.8", "input":"<PROMPT_PLACEHOLDER>", "max_tokens":1500}'
```

carla: debug-bot can collect traces if you push the req ids. @debug-bot please run trace-collect on req_8a3f,req_8a41,req_8a9c,req_8b00 and put bundle in s3://redwood-support/1799964821/

debug-bot: @carla acknowledged. Kicking off trace collection for 4 IDs. ETA ~4m. Logs + perf-profiles > s3://redwood-support/1799964821/trace_bundle.tar.gz :robot_face:

devon: For the latency-sample run, let's pick a prompt set of 30 samples: 20 short (tokens ~400), 10 long (tokens ~1800). Concurrency: ramp 1 -> 25 -> 50 over 10m. Target sustained RPS ~12. Use same model version and headers. Important: include warmup calls to populate KV cache.

kiara: I'll ask ACME to run a smoke test, but we need a clean staging job. Can someone drop a vegeta or hey command we can use? Also need expected failure modes to look for (502s, token truncation, p95 spikes).

devon: Example vegeta plan:

```bash
# replace <PROMPT> loop with file of 30 prompts, one per line
cat prompts.txt | vegeta attack -connections=50 -rate=12 -duration=10m | vegeta report
```

Also attach prompt set: prompts.txt contains 20 short lines ("Summarize the following..." ~400 tokens) and 10 long lines (legal doc rewrite ~1800 tokens). I'll push a minimal prompts.txt to the s3 bundle.

morgan: Adding a note: capture `runtime_metrics` at 1s granularity and include `gpu_util`, `kv_cache_hit_ratio`, `inflight_tokens` in bundle.

carla: Copy that. debug-bot will also capture perf snapshots and the model-variant routing decisions.

debug-bot: Perf bundle uploaded: s3://redwood-support/1799964821/trace_bundle.tar.gz. Vegeta plan + prompts.txt at s3://redwood-support/1799964821/vegeta_plan.tar.gz :white_check_mark:

morgan: Great. Next steps: 1) Run vegeta from staging against dedicated test pool with same kernel/quant profiles. 2) Attach the raw curl logs and the vegeta report. 3) If we reproduce, dump the server-side request logs for the timeframe.

devon: If reproduced, also collect `kernel-selection.log` and `batch-queue-stats` to see if we hit slow kernels on long sequences.

kiara: I'll notify ACME and request a 30m window. 

carla: assigning follow-up ticket #SUP-4891 to track bundle and results. I'll update here when job finishes.

morgan: thanks team :pray:

carla: [later] Vegeta job completed. Attached report shows p95 spike at 3m mark coinciding with cache miss streak. Report: s3://redwood-support/1799964821/vegeta_report.html

devon: digging into kernel-selection.log now. Initial impression: fallback to fp16-kernel for 32% of long requests, which increases latency for those shots. Will propose a canary quantization rollback.

kiara: please keep me posted, I'll hold ACME update until we have root cause.

morgan: received, will stand by for devon remediation plan.
